checks.name: Independent example has separately rounded compute, storage and workspace costs
Request and duration units produce equivalent workloads
Rate display conversion does not alter monthly estimation
Malformed, empty, grouped and excessive precision inputs are rejected without rewriting
Maximum supported workload remains exact beyond floating-point products
No compute usage retains applicable storage and workspace fees
CPU-only mode excludes accelerator allocation without inventing a free total
Unknown custom workspace fees preserve known usage and unknown total
Half-cent rounding occurs after aggregate monthly resource usage
Unknown identifiers and invalid display values cannot become costs
